personality_one_liner: A vibrant, energetic social-gastronomy game where food discovery feels like a tactile, rewarding adventure.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Cards must have breathing room, layout uses modular rounded shapes with clear grouping.

do's: Use blur on bottom tab bar
Use blur on floating search/filter chips over the map
Use blur on bottom-sheet drag handles/headers
dont's: Do not use blur on standard list items or cards
Do not use blur for form fields

screens.name: Odkrywaj (Discover / Map)
screens.purpose: Interactive map showing restaurants and Gastro-Routes with game-like pins.

states.loading: Map skeleton or centered branded spinner
states.empty: No places found in this area - search elsewhere prompt
states.error: Failed to load map data - retry button

screens.layout: Full-bleed Leaflet WebView map. Floating highly rounded search bar/chips (glassmorphic) at the top safe area. A bottom sheet (using @gorhom/bottom-sheet) displaying recommended 'Gastro-Routes' (A->B) and nearby places. Pins should be tactile and pop.

screens.name: Stoły (Open Tables / Events)
screens.purpose: Feed of available tables and official restaurant events.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty dining table - 'No open tables nearby, maybe start one!'
states.error: Failed to load events - retry button

screens.layout: Vertical scroll of chunky, highly rounded cards (radius lg). 'OFICJALNE WYDARZENIE' (Official Event) cards are visually distinct: framed with a gold/green accent (`rarityLegendary` or `brandSecondary`), prominent discount badges, and a clear seats counter (e.g., 4/10). Hero images use top-to-bottom gradient scrims to ensure readable text over food photos.

screens.name: Wyzwania (Challenges & Cards)
screens.purpose: Mission board, Duels, and the Collectible Card Book.

states.empty: Illustration of a closed book - 'No challenges available right now'

screens.layout: Segmented control at the top (Misje, Pojedynki, Księga Kart). 'Misje' uses a quest-board layout (stacked cards with XP rewards). 'Pojedynki' shows active duels (symmetrical opponent layout) with a tactile Rock-Paper-Scissors input and a deadline countdown. 'Księga Kart' displays collectible cards in a grid; cards have colored borders based on rarity tokens and class icons.

screens.name: Czaty (Chats)

states.empty: Illustration of a silent chat bubble - 'Start a conversation with a Yummiteer'

screens.layout: Standard message list with generous padding. Avatars are wrapped in colored rings corresponding to the user's specialization (Class) to reinforce RPG elements. Unread messages have a `brandPrimary` dot.

screens.name: Profil (Character Profile)
screens.purpose: RPG-style character sheet showing stats, XP, class, and badges.

states.empty: N/A - Profile always has base stats

screens.layout: Top hero section featuring a class-themed colored banner (e.g., `classFoodie` background) and the user's avatar. Prominent level indicator (thick circular progress) and XP bar. Below, a grid of earned badges (like game achievements). A modular card for privacy settings and account management at the bottom.

hero_event.alt: Desert Lane Food Festival with bunting and crowds

discover_card.alt: Group of friends gathered around a table eating and sharing food

collectible_card_demo.alt: Stack of collectible game cards on a table

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 'Tactile / Playful' personality. Cards must have `lg` (24px) border radius and chunky tap targets (min 44x44pt).
Implement the custom RPG color palette carefully: use rarity colors (Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary) for collectible card borders/accents, and class colors for character avatars and profile themes.
For Official Events (OFICJALNE WYDARZENIE), use the `rarityLegendary` or `brandSecondary` (Fresh Green) color as a prominent border or badge to make them stand out in the feed.
Use 'Fredoka' for all headings and large numbers (like XP, levels, and seat counters), and 'Nunito' for body text. Cap font weights at 500.
Any image used as a background (e.g., on event cards or profile banners) MUST have a gradient-to-dark scrim (top-to-bottom) applied before text is placed over it to guarantee WCAG contrast.
Map functionality is critical: ensure the Leaflet WebView is full-bleed and underlying map interactions do not conflict with floating UI elements (like search chips) or the Gorhom bottom sheet.
Implement haptic feedback exactly as mapped in the JSON for gamification actions (card flips, dueling, leveling up).
